summary: A Print (PDF) button: PlayMaker's own PDF writer makes the scene or the whole play in Diana's format (title page, cast, numbered US Letter pages) and opens it in a new tab to print or save.
label: optional

params.name: text
params.description: One scene: exactly one {row.field} on a row screen, such as play-print "{row.text}"

params.name: from
params.description: The whole play: every row of this data the reader can read, in stored order; the data needs a text field

data.reads: Rows the page was already given under the data's read rule (or one row's field).

permissions: Anyone who can see the screen; it prints only what that reader may read.
replaces: Copying the play into a word processor to format and print it.
limits: No email or locked PDF yet (PlayMaker's email-print-pdf is not wrapped).
